title.narrative: Voter Outreach for Transparent Elections - Fiji (VOTE-Fiji)

description.narrative: The project aims to fortify the Fijian Elections Office (FEO), on the basis that a more transparent process, more aware and involved voters, combined with a stronger gender-sensitive approach, will enhance future electoral processes including local government and national elections. Rooted in structural challenges, it strives for a representative and inclusive democracy, acknowledging and addressing societal and cultural barriers. Building on successful collaborations during the 2022 General Election, it aligns strategically with UNDPs Pacific Strategy, focusing on gender equality and peace. It envisions increased civic understanding, fostering public participation and trust, while incorporating international best practices for a fair electoral system.
